# Nexory Translations

Community translations for closed-source Nexory applications. For open-source projects, submit translations directly to their main repositories.

## Structure
* `<app>/EN.json` — Source strings (auto-generated, do not edit).
* `<app>/<LANG>.json` — Translations named by uppercase [IETF language tag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) (e.g., `SV.json`, `PT-BR.json`). If your language isnt IETF supported, contact me and we will come up with a good solution.

## How to Contribute
See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)** for instructions on adding or updating translations directly in your browser.
